name: music controller
description: Media controller with 150x150 album art, slow-scrolling track & artist text, interactive seek bar, transport controls, and audio source selector.
author: FuncOverlay

settingsSchema.label: Text Scroll Speed (px/s)
settingsSchema.description: Slow horizontal scroll speed in pixels per second when the track name or artist does not fit (10-80).

settingsSchema.label: Focus App When Selecting Source
settingsSchema.description: Try to bring the selected media player's window/music focus forward when switching sources from the dropdown.

settingsSchema.label: Show Audio Source Dropdown
settingsSchema.description: Display the top-right dropdown button to switch which media app to control and capture metadata from.
